parole.significato: A person with poor judgment and taste; a foolish or silly person.
parole.testo: Pseudo-Latinism, possibly an alteration of earlier goofus (first attested in the 1920s) due to influence from Scots doof (“simpleton”). Scots doof is derived from Low German doof (“deaf”, with a secondary sense of “idiotic, stupid”). The Low German word is cognate with English deaf. By surface analy

parole.significato: To propose or put forward for discussion or consideration.
parole.testo: From Latin prōpōnō (“place before; offer, propose”), via Scots [Term?].
